name: C+M+B Glaubenshotel
beschreibung: The C+M+B Glaubenshotel is a special hotel concept in Tirol. It is aimed at guests seeking a contemplative retreat. The furnishings are simple and functional. Programs on Christian themes and meditation are offered. The hotel values silence and inner reflection. It is suitable for individuals and groups for shared faith experiences. The surroundings offer opportunities for walks and nature experiences.
